name: google-docs-mcp
description: Create, read, edit, format and search your Google Docs from Claude, with secure Google sign-in.
long_description:
Google Docs for Claude connects Claude Desktop to the Google Docs in your Google Drive through the Google Docs and Google Drive APIs. Claude can create documents, read them, append, insert, replace and delete text, apply headings, formatting, alignment, lists, links, tables and page breaks, and find documents by name or content. Deleting a document only moves it to the Drive trash.

**One-time setup:** in Google Cloud Console, enable the Google Docs API and Google Drive API and create an OAuth client of type *Desktop app*. Enter its Client ID and Client secret in this extension's settings, then ask Claude to "sign in to Google" and approve access in your browser.

Your Google tokens stay on your computer and are only sent to Google. This extension is not affiliated with or endorsed by Google.

tools.name: get_auth_status
tools.description: Check whether the extension is signed in to Google with the required permissions.

tools.name: authenticate
tools.description: Start Google sign-in and get the link to approve access.

tools.name: sign_out
tools.description: Revoke Google access and delete the locally stored tokens.

tools.name: create_document
tools.description: Create a new Google Doc, optionally with initial text.

tools.name: get_document
tools.description: Read a Google Doc's text and structure, including exact positions.

tools.name: list_documents
tools.description: List your Google Docs, most recently modified first.

tools.name: delete_document
tools.description: Move a Google Doc to the Google Drive trash.

tools.name: copy_document
tools.description: Copy a Google Doc under a new title.

tools.name: append_text
tools.description: Append text to the end of a Google Doc.

tools.name: insert_text
tools.description: Insert text at a specific position in a Google Doc.

tools.name: replace_text
tools.description: Replace every occurrence of a phrase in a Google Doc.

tools.name: delete_text
tools.description: Delete a range of text, optionally checking its current content first.

tools.name: format_text
tools.description: Apply bold, italic, underline, strikethrough, font, size or colors to text.

tools.name: set_paragraph_style
tools.description: Apply Title, Subtitle, Heading 1-6 or Normal text styles to paragraphs.

tools.name: set_alignment
tools.description: Align paragraphs to the start, center or end, or justify them.

tools.name: insert_page_break
tools.description: Insert a page break at a specific position.

tools.name: insert_table
tools.description: Insert an empty table with the given rows and columns.

tools.name: insert_link
tools.description: Turn existing text into an http, https or mailto link.

tools.name: create_bulleted_list
tools.description: Turn paragraphs into a bulleted, numbered or checkbox list.

tools.name: search_documents
tools.description: Search your Google Docs by name and/or content.

tools.name: find_text
tools.description: Find a phrase in a Google Doc and return its exact positions.

google_client_id.title: Google OAuth Client ID
google_client_id.description: Client ID of your Google Cloud OAuth client (type "Desktop app"), ending in .apps.googleusercontent.com. See the extension's README for the one-time setup.

google_client_secret.title: Google OAuth Client secret
google_client_secret.description: Client secret of the same OAuth client. Stored securely by Claude Desktop.

limit_drive_access.title: Limit Drive access to this extension's files
limit_drive_access.description: Least privilege: only documents created or opened by this extension are visible to Drive operations (list, search, copy, trash). Leave off to work with all your existing Google Docs. Sign in again after changing this.

oauth_callback_port.title: Sign-in callback port
oauth_callback_port.description: Local port (on 127.0.0.1) that receives the Google sign-in redirect. Change it only if another program uses this port.

debug_logging.title: Debug logging
debug_logging.description: Write detailed diagnostic logs (secrets are always redacted). Useful when reporting a problem.
